I rent this small maize plot, so I want to make it count, but I can't pour too much money into land that isn't mine. Since maize needs nitrogen and I have some schooling to know how to use it, I'll buy a bag of NPK and some urea for this plot — it's only a quarter hectare so one or two bags goes a long way. I'll plant an improved maize variety since the agro-dealer stocks it and it pairs well with the fertilizer. I won't bother with manure on rented land or with irrigation since I rely on the rains, and I'll mostly work it myself with just a little hired help for weeding since I have other plots to manage too.
